Two new earth tones, appended at the end (nothing shifts).).

lighting._note: Board-only lighting presets (passthrough shows the real room). key = sun/moon colour, ambient = sky/shadow fill, rim = edge light from behind, energy = key strength; optional key_elev/key_az (degrees, sun height and direction; az 0 = from the front) rim_scale and ambient_strength (default 0.9). Day and golden_hour retuned 2026-10-17 toward Siddharth's warm sunlit reference image (lighting mood only).
